races.title: British Stallion Studs EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.drawBiasExplanation: Middle to high draws often favored on straight Rowley Mile

verdict.comment: The shortlist comprises interesting newcomers MOONFALL, This Guy and Military Code in that order of preference.

comments.exclamation: Yard is 0-39 with 2yos but this colt showed promise with 40-1 third in the Brocklesby
comments.henrythenate: Colt by Mayson and first foal of a 1m2f winner for his stable; check the betting
comments.militarycode: Wootton Bassett colt from a good family; represents powerful yard; warrants respect
comments.moonfall: 200,000gns yearling; half-brother to a Group 3 winner for his stable; very interesting
comments.slayqueen: 72,000gns yearling; by Acclamation; sole filly in the field; market instructive
comments.thisguy: £170,000 yearling; by Blue Point; sibling to six winners; respected yard; possibilities

races.raceComment: exclamation is strongly preferred with a score of 24.0%, holding clear edges in better ratings and better suited by conditions and superior course form and more progressive over moonfall. Going is a significant concern - yet to win on Good ground from 1 attempts. Could develop into tactical affair with no obvious pace-setter. Key attributes include improving, though step up in class and unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

races.drawBiasExplanation: Middle to high draws often favored on straight Rowley Mile

verdict.comment: A handful of these showed significant promise on debut last year, with Mishriff's bother KALEIDO possibly the pick of them.

comments.competizione: Related to winners but Keleido looks yard first string unless betting hints otherwise
comments.dragonflame: Promise on first of two runs last year but best watched in this hot-looking race
comments.great: Second on 6f Goodwood debut and may have won but for meeting interference; will improve
comments.hockney: Showcasing colt who will need to be smart to win this on debut
comments.indiansprings: Shaped well when third on 6f AW debut in December; sure to progress now tackling 7f
comments.kaleido: Brother to Mishriff; promising second of 16 on 7f Doncaster debut (soft) in October
comments.licencetoconquer: Bred to have a future but a watching brief is the percentage call on debut
comments.nakeeb: Travelled well long way when third on 1m course debut so drop to 7f could suit; promising
comments.raafedd: Caught eye on AW debut; entered in 2,000 Guineas; potential for significant improvement
comments.regalguest: Third on AW last month but a good deal more needed to get heavily involved here
comments.sheikhraj: Second on Kempton debut last August but only sixth there a month later; has been gelded
comments.silentstorm: Brother to a smart sort but probably best watched on debut
comments.timeallowed: Gelded son of Lope De Vega who has a good standard to aim at on debut

races.raceComment: kaleido is marginally preferred with a score of 19.5%. Going is a significant concern - yet to win on Good ground from 1 attempts. Key attributes include improving, though returning from absence and step up in class and unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

verdict.comment: A really good race featuring a few 4yos who should have more to offer. Top of that list is HARPER'S FERRY after his Doncaster win.

comments.bopedro: 0-14 last year but recorded some good efforts in strong races and he's a former C&D winner
comments.brioni: Useful 1m/1m2f winner last year; failed to stay 1m4f here final start; off six months
comments.bulletpoint: Made it 2-3 in h'caps when beating Tribal Chief over C&D in autumn; more to come in 2025
comments.desperatedan: Improver over 1m in the mud last autumn but reappears in a hot race
comments.harpersferry: Well suited by drop to 1m when making all at Doncaster final 3yo start; more to come
comments.hiromichi: Won on 2024 reappearance and returns with yard continuing in good form; could go well
comments.mythicalguest: Both wins over 1m2f on good to firm; a watching brief is advised on return
comments.noisyjazz: Very low-mileage 4yo; from an excellent yard so should have more to offer in 2025
comments.skukuza: Excellent second in last year's Britannia; off since but still much respected on return
comments.tribalchief: Very progressive as a 3yo, winning four and second to Bullet Point over C&D; player
comments.urbansprawl: Won on AW recently and this five-time turf scorer could have fitness edge on some here
comments.waitingallnight: Two July Course wins last year; ran okay on AW over winter and back on winning mark
comments.zainblue: Cheekpieces added when winning over 1m at York last autumn; minus headgear on return

races.raceComment: skukuza is marginally preferred with a score of 56.7%, holding clear edges in better ratings and more reliable profile over zainblue. Won 1 of last 3 starts. verdict.comment: This might go to progressive SHANTWOPOINTFIVE (nap) who posted a good effort last month and should be aided by a stronger gallop here.

comments.alltheglory: Slightly below form last time but has generally done well this season; can have a say
comments.batwomen: Comfortable winner of four-runner race at Fontwell on Friday; has 6lb penalty here
comments.bethpage: 4-7 in handicaps after last month's small-field win; not yet fully exposed
comments.couldbetrouble: Made all in new headgear in March but 4lb rise may be enough to leave this 10yo vulnerable
comments.epinephrine: Clear winner on handicap debut; well held since but still looks interesting over new trip
comments.gilbertina: Placed off this mark last month but, after 21 hurdle runs, she looks exposed
comments.greyval: Scored at Chepstow last month but may find some of the others better handicapped here
comments.iledejersey: Well handicapped on old form; not beaten far last month, after a long absence
comments.jenadoudairies: Needs to up her game here but she's an unexposed mare from a top stable
comments.maskeddance: Yet to hit peak peak since returning from a break, and latest run was very disappointing
comments.mermaidscave: 5-10 for stable after Fakenham win in January; further progress is possible
comments.midnightginger: Second off her reduced mark at Ludlow in February but younger mares appeal more here
comments.moltobene: Has not kicked on from her big-field Chepstow win in October; cheekpieces now added
comments.ofcourseyoucan: Managed only seventh in last month's Newbury Grade 2 and effectively 2lb higher here
comments.pawapuri: No better than a respectable fourth on stable debut but may yet revive for Dan Skelton
comments.pretending: Won this in 2024; needs to better recent form but may be aided by new cheekpieces
comments.shantwopointfive: Ran big race in defeat at Chepstow and may still have a bigger effort in her; good chance
comments.springsagirl: Tends to race a bit too freely but is 2-6 over hurdles and may yet do better
comments.sundaysoldier: 50-1 second in a Listed race in February but well beaten on subsequent handicap return
comments.sunsethill: Kept on for second in valuable 2m series final at Kelso last month; this trip will suit

races.raceComment: sundaysoldier is marginally preferred with a score of 58.3%, holding clear edges in better ratings and more progressive over midnightginger. Placed in 3 of last 6 starts. Ground (Good) looks ideal with 4 wins from 17 starts in similar conditions. Excellent course form of 5/19 at cheltenham. Key attributes include optimal distance and improving, though inconsistent profile need consideration.

verdict.comment: Plenty to consider and WOBWOBWOB (nap) may be the pick. Cairn Gorm and Aberama Gold are others to look at.

comments.aberamagold: Hasn't won since 2023 but runner-up in Class 4 handicaps on last two starts
comments.americanbay: Was useful for Harry Charlton including 6f novice win; needs to build on stable debut run
comments.beyondborders: Ex-Karl Burke; no win since 2023; sold for 22,000gns in January; must run as well as ever
comments.cairngorm: Beaten in two starts this year, but still well weighted on his best
comments.dakotagold: Grand old horse, the winner of 16 of his 71 races including C&D win, but may need this run
comments.danzan: Last win came over 7f in 2023, off since October; third behind Fortamour in this last term
comments.fortamour: 6-20 record at Ripon; won this in 2022 and last year; off since October and may need rain
comments.larochette: Two 6f wins on testing turf in FRA, sold for 20,000euros in 2024; well beaten stable debut
comments.mrwagyu: Formerly smart handicapper; 15 wins from 94 starts including two victories over C&D
comments.rockopera: Two Class 4 sprint handicap wins last year; competitively weighted after five months off
comments.thegoodbiscuit: Ex-Jack Channon; hasn't won since 2023 and needs to run as well as ever for new stable
comments.tiriac: Ex-Jack Channon; won two 6f Class 4 handicaps last term; sold for 20,000gns in October
comments.valentinecatcher: Had only five starts, winning twice including Class 4 Nottingham handicap last summer
comments.wobwobwob: Out of form when last seen October, but won 15-runner Class 4 Thirsk handicap last spring

races.raceComment: fortamour is confidently preferred with a score of 57.9%, holding clear edges in better suited by conditions and stronger recent form and superior course form over rockopera. Won 1 of last 6 starts. Likely to be steadily run with pressure on the leader, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.
